overview_description.description: OrderJet is an innovative F&B solution that improves customer experience and helps business owners increase efficiency and lower costs. It is suitable for all types of restaurants, coffee shops, food courts, and food trucks, and supports dine-in, take-out, and delivery services.

product.name: OrderJet Contactless Dining
product.description: A mobile app-based system allowing customers to order and pay for meals via QR codes at tables or room service without waitstaff interaction.

product.name: OrderJet Delivery Service
product.description: A platform feature that allows customers to select restaurants and order food for delivery to their specified locations, with saved addresses for future orders.

product.name: OrderJet To-Go and Vehicle Pickup
product.description: A service allowing customers to order food for pickup and notify the restaurant upon arrival to have the order delivered to their vehicle or parking spot.
